_comment_platform: iOS capabilities, used when the run targets iOS (runner --platform ios, or APPIUM_PLATFORM=ios). Mirrors android.caps.json: everything here is sent as a capability EXCEPT `devices` and any key starting with `_`, which are treated as comments because JSON has no comment syntax.
_comment_version: platformVersion must match the OS on the attached devices, or session creation fails. Update when the devices are upgraded.
_comment_app: iOS identifies the app by BUNDLE ID, not appPackage/appActivity. Replace with the real bundle id of the iOS build (Xcode: target > General > Bundle Identifier).
_comment_noReset: Same intent as Android: keep the signed-in session between runs so a soak is not 100 fresh logins.
_comment_port: XCUITest's per-worker port is wdaLocalPort (WebDriverAgent), the counterpart of Android's systemPort. The runner adds the worker index, so device 1 gets 8100, device 2 gets 8101, and so on.
_comment_wda: First run on each device builds and installs WebDriverAgent, which needs Xcode signing set up. usePrebuiltWDA speeds later runs; drop it if WDA is not yet installed on the device.
_comment_devices: UDIDs of the real iOS devices to run on, in device order (device 1 first). Find them with: xcrun xctrace list devices. Empty means 'use whatever is connected'.
